title: CMB Blackbody Temperature from SDT Spation Equilibrium
equations: SDT: T_CMB = (P_CMB / sigma_SB)^(1/4) where P_CMB is spation boundary pressure
Peak: nu_max = 2.821 * k_B * T / h (Wien's law)
pipeline: 1. Verify Wien displacement law at T = 2.7255 K
conclusion: 3/3 tests pass. nu_max=160.2 GHz (exp ~160 GHz, err 0.0155%). T_CMB=2.7255 K. SDT spation equilibrium reproduces CMB spectrum.
